commands.command: Design or implement the next behavior-retention and wrong-history guard required before any capability-belief PPO continuation.
commands.name: m154_capability_belief_behavior_gate_design

decision_rule: Capability-belief training cannot proceed to PPO unless the gate explicitly checks behavior retention, rollout margin, reset/zero-response/wrong-history degradation, and no actor-input leakage.
failure_criteria: gate only reports supervised capability loss and ignores closed-loop behavior
gate permits driver promotion from M153 smoke alone
gate drops M142/M62-style behavior retention or strict proof-surface checks
gate introduces oracle labels or hidden dynamics into deployable actor observations
hypothesis: A capability-belief auxiliary can be useful only if paired with a behavior gate that prevents the supervised belief objective from washing out rollout-margin and wrong-history proof surfaces.
success_criteria: specify the exact benchmark and intervention checks for a capability-belief trained checkpoint
preserve current P0 human-view actor input contract
include M142/M133-style behavior retention or critical-key guard requirements
include reset-hidden, zero-response, zero-action, and wrong-history degradation checks
state pass/fail thresholds before the next PPO or actor-coupling run
